source: Native baseline 393-query server logs, excluding 3 restart preflight queries and all warmups; aligned and checked against official query order.
mechanism: Native RRF sums 1/(60+rank) for each present arm (semantic, bm25, graph, temporal). Adding the graph arm changes rank contributions; no cross-encoder exists to correct relevance afterward.
limit: Graph and temporal switches changed together. Log evidence points to graph fusion, with no temporal arm hits observed; separate single-switch ablations would be needed to isolate causality fully.
